decisions.reason: As a core sensor module that fits the firm's modular automation platform and R&D-led expansion, it likely strengthens the ecosystem even if volumes are still ramping up.
An industrial AC voltage input module directly extends the established control and measurement range and is the kind of complementary building block this firm typically retains.
A four-channel solid state relay module is a natural companion to sensing and controller products, so keeping it supports cross-selling within the modular system.
The server room monitoring kit packages existing capabilities into an accessible solution for organizational customers and is worth keeping while the firm is in growth mode.
